title: Book Our Extraordinary Ocean's Five Flat | Rosemary Beach Rental – Rosemary Beach®
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

First Floor Flat

This gorgeous two bedroom condo in Rosemary is the perfect location for a small family to enjoy the best of Rosemary Beach. Located on St Augustine Park and near the Cabana Pool, this beach condo features a king master suite plus an additional guest room with a queen bed.

The unit includes a full kitchen plus dining area for up to six guests. Opening to the living room is a comfortable sitting area with sofa and reading chairs to enjoy the large flat screen TV. Open the double french doors onto the private patio featuring wicker chairs and gorgeous views of the large St Augustine Park across the street. The kids can enjoy the playground just down the road or take advantage of the activities at the St Augustine Amphitheater – both seconds away from your doorstep!

Kids will enjoy the built-in bunks with separate lighting while adults can sleep in total comfort in the king master suite or queen guest bedroom.

THIS PROPERTY BOOKS 7 NIGHTS (SATURDAY TO SATURDAY) SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER
